claim_boundary: AARM-inspired evidence for supported memory-mediated actions only; this prototype does not claim AARM conformance, certification, community verification, or universal interception.

mappings.implementation: Every supported public memory action enters one gateway before retrieval or model use.
Session, prior-receipt, role, purpose, audience, destination, tenant, and program context drive deterministic policy.
ALLOW, DENY, MODIFY, STEP_UP, or DEFER, with unresolved and timed-out pending actions failing closed.
Canonical, content-bound receipt fields are signed with a per-agent Ed25519 development key and verify offline.
mappings.limitations: The development-key trust model does not protect against an administrator controlling both storage and signing key.

mappings.implementation: A non-owner RLS role, bounded read tools, and content-safe events provide scoped evidence.
mappings.limitations: No full SIEM interoperability or dynamic credential broker is implemented.

scope: Supported memory-mediated actions in the synthetic Gluevenir Bio demonstration
